title: ShiLang Features
subtitle: Detailed feature descriptions (Now / Talk / Meet / Echo / Trace)

now.title: Now (Home)
now.desc: The initial static sea surface shown after entering ShiLang. Acts as a calm starting point presenting recent activity and entry points to other features.

talk.title: Talk (Throw Bottle)
talk.desc: Users compose messages and toss them into the sea. They can choose emotion tags and the bottle's drift duration, then wait for others to pick them up.

meet.title: Meet (Retrieve Bottle)
meet.desc: Randomly pick up a stranger's mood bottle. You can view the content, respond, or interact.

echo.title: Echo (Bottle Replies)
echo.desc: Replies to bottles you've thrown appear here. You can choose to continue the conversation or click to end it.

trace.title: Trace (My Items)
trace.desc: Manage your posting history, view the current drift status of your bottles, and delete or archive messages.
